chunks: Say: He who knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth has revealed it to me; and He is surely forgiving and kind.
ai.seo_question: Who revealed the Quran according to Surah Al-Furqan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the perfection of the Quranic revelation by linking it to Allah's attribute of 'Ilm (Knowledge), specifically His awareness of the esoteric (batin) and exoteric (zahir) realms, which validates the authority of the Imams as inheritors of this divine knowledge. The mention of Forgiveness and Mercy serves as a spiritual reassurance that the weight of this profound revelation is balanced by divine grace, encouraging believers to engage with the text not with fear, but with hope and contemplation.
